about: The public keys that sign RELEASE-MANIFEST.json (ECDSA P-256, SHA-256, signature in IEEE P1363 form). The Hub reads this file from its own files; the desktop shell embeds the same file. Only an entry that says use "release" is a key. Releases are signed with the first key; the second is the next key, kept offline as well, so that a rotation does not need a new installer first. scripts/verify-release-source.py refuses to release while a placeholder or a test key is in this file. To change a key: run scripts/new-release-key.mjs with a path OUTSIDE the repository and put the entry it prints here, in a small pull request.
